title: Author a small purchased part (an LDO regulator) from datasheet excerpts and pass verification
instruction: The sensor node uses an ACME LDO3300-33SOT-TR regulator (part id acme-ldo3300-33) that is not defined yet, so `npx protoboard check` fails. Author it as a project-researched part from the datasheet text and the manufacturer CAD in inputs/ (read inputs/README.md first; there is no network access), with its evidence (sources.json, and terms.json recording the terms of the manufacturer files), so that `npx protoboard run part-verify --input part=acme-ldo3300-33` reports no errors and check reports no errors. Do not change src/.

graders.rubric: A UHD definition of the fictional ACME LDO3300-33SOT-TR regulator authored from its datasheet. 1. A header comment cites the datasheet and states modelling notes. 2. One interface per package pin with the right designator: 1 VIN power input 2.5-6.0 V, 2 GND, 3 EN logic input, 4 NC no connect, 5 VOUT 3.3 V power output. 3. Output current 300 mA and dropout, quiescent current, operating and absolute-maximum ranges are recorded with their datasheet sections. 4. Values not in the datasheet are not invented; anything assumed is an assumption trait. 5. The manufacturer CAD is bound as the body, cited with its sha256 and licence, and its terms are recorded in parts/evidence/acme-ldo3300-33/terms.json.

solution.say: Authored parts/local/acme-ldo3300-33.uhd.ts (five pins from the pin table, power domains, ratings, package SOT-23-5) with ACME's STEP and GLB bound as its CAD, and parts/evidence/acme-ldo3300-33/sources.json citing the datasheet and both CAD files with their sha256 and licence, and terms.json recording ACME's CAD terms for both files. part-verify: 0 errors, 1 warning (no mechanical interfaces, intended: it is soldered).
